newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends 0.6 pct lower as Dow stabilises.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends 0.6 pct lower as Dow stabilises.

text.p: Britain's leading blue chip index defied expectations of a bloody Monday and ended with only moderate losses as bargain hunting emerged in the wake of Friday's steep drop, dealers and strategists said.

World markets took their cue from Monday's Wall Street, where shares opened higher before slipping back. The Dow, which shed more than three percent on Friday, was down about three points at 7,691, when London markets closed.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares fell 30.8 points, or 0.6 percent, to 4,835.0, as decliners beat advancers by a margin of two-to-one.
The FTSE 250 index ended 34.6 points lower at 4,663.6.
